context: A police officer briefs about a fraud case
purpose: Teach: 儀礼/貫く/浮き彫り/造船/応じる/騙し/辞退/モニタリング

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、被害者への儀礼的な挨拶も、慎重に扱います。
lines.en: We're handling victim contact with particular care in this case.
lines.style: Even, measured opening. Professional composure. Steady eye contact. Each phrase deliberate and unhurried, like reading from careful notes.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 捜査方針を貫く姿勢、印象的ですね。
lines.en: The way you're committed to following that investigative path — that's impressive.
lines.style: Genuine curiosity, slightly tentative. Leans forward slightly. Tone is sincere but searching, testing whether Takeda will elaborate.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。組織内部の構造、浮き彫りになりました。
lines.en: Yes. The internal structure of the organization has come into sharp focus.
lines.style: Confirmation tone, matter-of-fact. Brief pause before 'focus' — letting it settle. Clinical precision, no elaboration offered.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 造船業界での詐欺、共通点があるんですか。
lines.en: Are there common patterns in the fraud cases across the shipbuilding industry?
lines.style: Direct question, genuinely seeking information. Slight lift at the end. Engaged but not pushing — giving space for a full answer.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。被害者の要求に応じる迅速対応、警察の使命です。
lines.en: Yes. Responding quickly to victims' requests — that's core to what we do.
lines.style: Calm reaffirmation. Slight weight on 'core' — this is principle, not procedure. Steady, almost protective of the statement.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 騙し手口、業界全体で監視必要ですね。
lines.en: The deception methods are consistent enough that industry-wide monitoring seems essential.
lines.style: Thoughtful, building toward conclusion. Slight increase in confidence. Genuinely probing — not asking permission, but inviting agreement.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。出頭辞退の容疑者、モニタリング下にあります。
lines.en: Yes. The suspects who've refused to appear are under active surveillance.
lines.style: Final statement, calm and definitive. Slight hardening of tone — assurance, not threat. Closes the line with quiet authority.
